method.curation: Kept only picks that sit inside the VITRINE NOIR voice. Dropped ['glass', 'love', 'fast'] — a paper-cut bride, a knight and noblewoman and a pixelated road do not belong in a cold glass-case film, and padding the count would have cost more than the extra coverage was worth. The A-roll already carries 9 no-person plates.
